Low volume isn't WEAK. ⚠️

A low volume node on the profile is where price moved so fast that almost nobody traded: one side was in total control. When price comes back to that thin zone, it usually gets rejected just as fast. Buying "because there's nothing there" means buying right into the sellers' zone.

1️⃣ Mark the low volume nodes on your volume profile
2️⃣ Expect fast rejection there, not easy acceptance
3️⃣ Confirm with delta: aggressive sellers at the LVN = rejection
